title: A Cipher for the Border
author: Zephyrine Halloran
blurb: Quentin Fairweather, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, works cases no one wants attributed. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
